description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_AttrTypes, which provides a lookup system for attribute types to their corresponding handler objects within the HTMLPurifier library. It includes methods for constructing the type mappings, retrieving a specific type, and setting new implementations.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrTypes
classes.description: A class that manages a collection of attribute type definitions used in HTMLPurifier to validate and handle different attribute data types.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the attribute types with default implementations for a variety of attribute data types.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves an attribute type handler object based on the provided type string.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Replaces or sets a new implementation object for a given attribute type.
